name: bent knee lying twist (on stability ball)
description: A lying twist with bent knees while your upper back is on a stability ball. It trains the obliques and trunk control.
instructions: Lie with your upper back on a stability ball and your knees bent at 90 degrees.
Extend your arms out to the sides for balance.
Rotate your knees and hips slowly to one side.
Bring them back through the centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square to the ceiling.
